newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Micron Tech estimates cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Micron Tech estimates cut.

text.p: Lehman Brothers said on Wednesday it lowered its 1997 and 1998 earnings estimates on Micron Technology Inc, because of softer order trends in the industry and inventory and pricing-related issues.
-- Analyst Michael Gumport said he lowered his fourth quarter estimate to $0.44 per share from $0.54 per share, bringing his 1997 estimate to $1.65 per share from $1.75.
-- Gumport said he lowered his fiscal 1998 earnings estimate to $2.15 per share from $2.75 per share.
-- Gumport said his third quarter estimate was $0.45 per share. Third quarter results were due on June 16.
-- "Overall, in the industry, we are hearing reports of softer orders over the past three weeks, which makes us believe upside is limited from here," Gumport said.
-- "There is also some modest inventory buildup at Micron Technology and some pricing pressure," he said.

-- Sanford Bernstein analyst Vadim Zlotnikov said he was expecting the company to report earnings of around $0.40 per share in the third quarter instead of his $0.50 per share estimate, because Micron Technology held back some of its memory chip production as inventory in the quarter.
-- But Merrill Lynch analyst Thomas Kurlak said business was good for Micron Technology and inventory build was slight.
-- Shares of the memory chip maker were off 2-1/8 at 39-1/8 in brisk trade.
